verdict.rationale: Runloop's Devboxes are general-purpose Linux sandboxes that can run arbitrary languages via SSH/CLI or blueprints, implying multi-language code execution is possible, but there is no explicit documentation of a code-execution API returning structured/rich results (stdout, artifacts, rich media) per language runtime. Missing for 10: explicit multi-language execution API docs, rich result/output formatting examples, and language-specific runtime support lists.
